brief:
Occupation forces and settler militias have maintained a strict siege on three Palestinian houses in the Ras al-Ein area of Qassra town south of Nablus for the twentieth consecutive day, Shehab Wire reported. The families living in the homes remain trapped as the blockade continues without interruption.

The siege represents part of a broader effort by settlers and military forces to pressure Palestinians into leaving the area. Residents face severe restrictions on movement and access to basic supplies. Authorities have not announced a timeline for lifting the blockade, which officials say is intended to seize control of the land and displace the families currently occupying it.
